title: Very narrow, smaller then the width of a egg carton. Don’t waste your money.
text:
Very narrow, smaller then the width of a egg carton. Don’t waste your money.. I just received this and What a disappointment !
This is Not Big! It’s a joke.
This is thick and VERY Narrow. I now can see by the picture all the veggie and fruit are tiny that they show. Or is it not real food?

The inside width is 3 1/4 inches. To small for regular apples or tomatoes to be stuff in this, and I do not want to Squash my grapes in this. This is even narrower then a egg carton. I measured.
I also did not received the bottom part to this?

I have other plastic containers that look like this, but there wider. My other ones are useful, not this one.

I bought extra of My other ones as there also good for using in a RV , for tee’s, socks, hubby’s shirts. And we can see everything.
This is even too narrow for socks or underwear!

This will probably show up at the $1.00 store.

product_metadata.title: Spectrum Diversified Hexa in-Fridge Large Refrigerator Bin for Storage and Organization of Fruit Vegetables Produce and More, 15 x 3.75 x 4.25, Clear/Dark Gray
features: AIR FLOW: A removeable interior tray keeps food raised off the bottom of the bin, improving air flow for your produce, fruit, and vegetables, allowing them to ripen both evenly and naturally.
STACKABLE STORAGE: Raised feet allow these bins to be stacked atop one another and promote vertical storage.
SEE IT ALL: This clear tray allows you to easily see what is inside; you can also use dry erase markers to label the bin, making for easier storage distinction. (Markers not included.)

EASY ACCESS: A scooped front handle cutout allows for easy access to cooking ingredients, afternoon snacks, and more; when stacked, these cutouts make it easy to obtain contents without having to rearrange the entire refrigerator.
HEXAGONAL PATTERN: The hexagonal tray can be removed for easy cleaning, allowing you to freely wipe away any dirt or crumbs.
description: Organize your fridge in style with the HEXA In-Fridge Large Organizer Bin by Spectrum Diversified. Crafted from durable plastic, this bin is built for the long haul and will serve your fridge storage needs for years to come. A removable tray allows it to be cleaned between uses, minimizing the potential for cross-contamination. The tray also keeps food off the bottom of the bin, allowing for even air flow that helps your produce, fruit, or veggies to ripen both evenly and naturally. These trays can also be stacked vertically, helping you to organize your fridge vertically and maximize any potential empty space. A scooped front handle cutout makes for easy access to items stored within, and the clear plastic is dry-erase friendly, which allows you to label the bin for easy distinction of ingredient storage. Think about adding a few to your fridge to discern between meats and vegetables, or stack them vertically to keep your produce separate and tidy.

details.Care instructions: Wipe clean with a damp cloth, towel dry
